name: MMI
description: Medical Microinstruments, Inc. (MMI) is a medical robotics company founded in 2015 near Pisa (Calci), Italy, with U.S. operational headquarters in Jacksonville, Florida. The company develops the [Symani](/robot/mmi_symani) teleoperated robotic platform and NanoWrist micro-instruments for open microsurgery and super-microsurgery.
